role.roleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Wealth Services Platform

evidence.text: Maintained the month-end demand model that forecasts batch volume from client, account and report counts, refreshing the coefficients each quarter from the platform's job-history tables.
Planned compute and storage for each month-end cycle with the platform team, translating the forecast into node reservations and storage headroom in the capacity plan.

Month-end batch overruns fell from 9 per cycle to 2 per cycle over the six cycles after the re-sequenced valuation jobs went live, as recorded in the platform's overrun report against its published baseline of 9 overruns per cycle for the preceding half-year.

Coordinated capacity changes with the platform and finance teams in the monthly capacity review; reservation changes were approved by the platform manager and the cost impact was signed off by finance.

Wrote the assumptions note for each planning cycle, listing the model coefficients, the known limitation that ad-hoc adviser reports were outside the forecast and the hand-over items for the next cycle.
